tests.name: harness_result_without_usage_defaults_to_none
tests.description: Existing three-field HarnessResult construction remains valid
tests.arrange: Construct HarnessResult with exit_code, stdout, and stderr only
tests.assert: Usage is None and existing fields are unchanged

tests.name: harness_usage_is_immutable
tests.description: Normalized usage is an immutable value object with optional metrics
tests.arrange: Construct HarnessUsage with all four supported metrics
tests.assert: Mutation raises FrozenInstanceError and values retain their declared types

tests.name: read_atif_usage_normalizes_supported_metrics
tests.description: A complete final_metrics object maps only supported aggregate fields
tests.arrange: Write ATIF JSON with all standard metrics and an additional billing dimension
tests.assert: Supported metrics are normalized, integer USD becomes float, and the extra field is excluded

tests.name: read_atif_usage_returns_none_for_missing_or_invalid_document
tests.description: Missing, unreadable, and invalid JSON exports do not produce usage
tests.arrange: Use a missing path, an unreadable path, and an invalid JSON file
tests.assert: Every result is None and no exception escapes

tests.name: read_atif_usage_returns_none_for_non_object_final_metrics
tests.description: Null, string, and otherwise non-object final_metrics containers are rejected
tests.arrange: Write valid ATIF documents with non-object final_metrics values

tests.name: read_atif_usage_rejects_wrong_typed_fields_independently
tests.description: Boolean and other wrong-typed values do not invalidate valid sibling metrics
tests.arrange: Write final_metrics containing invalid token and cost values plus valid siblings
tests.assert: Affected fields are None while valid fields remain populated

tests.name: read_atif_usage_preserves_partial_supported_metrics
tests.description: Partial standard metrics remain useful without inventing zero values
tests.arrange: Write final_metrics with prompt tokens and an unknown billing field only
tests.assert: Prompt tokens are populated and all other supported fields are None

tests.name: read_atif_usage_handles_large_trajectory_without_logging_content
tests.description: Large trajectory content does not affect aggregate parsing or leak through diagnostics
tests.arrange: Write a large ATIF document containing sensitive marker text in steps and valid final_metrics
tests.assert: Usage is returned and captured logs do not contain trajectory marker text
